title: Junior Leather Goods Designer
note: Soft goods role covering handbags, small leather goods and accessories; UK-based permanent position (visa sponsorship not stated).

facts.summary: Junior designer supporting the Mulberry leather goods team, reporting to the Senior Leather Goods Designer.
facts.duties: Research trends and materials, sketch and render concepts, build physical mock-ups and prototypes, prepare tech specs, and work with product development and factories.
facts.requirements: Photoshop, Illustrator and InDesign; strong hand drawing; handbag construction knowledge; spec and mock-up experience; 3D software and factory experience a plus.
